The Ministry of Labor and Social Affairs took ten services online on the Ethiopian e-Services portal, which Addis Insight reports now carries 36 government institutions, up from five two years earlier.

The Federal Transport Authority announced it had launched 18 online services (vehicle quality assurance and import, cargo transport, public transport) on www.eservices.gov.et, per the Ethiopian News Agency.

Prime Minister Abiy inaugurated the Unified MESOB Application, which ENA says brings 27 services from across institutions to a single platform, and said MESOB one-stop service has reached 70 centres within a year.

Ethio Telecom launched the teleSign app, developed with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Justice and the Federal Documents Authentication and Registration Service, for online document authentication, power of attorney and professional licences, with payment by telebirr.
National ID Ethiopia's deck describes Mesob as a Fayda-based digital one-stop shop for e-government services, listed with agriculture and health services.

The Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration reports 1,088,787 business registration and licensing services delivered online across federal institutions, regional states and city administrations over three months, in categories including trade name clearance, licence renewal and amendment.
